name: dirxmldev-visual
description: Thin MCP/tool hooks for the DirXMLDev fishbone. There is no MCP server in DirXMLDev today (CLI-only). These tool definitions are the adapter surface; implementations are TypeScript helpers in src/hooks.ts and the VS Code commands.

tools.name: fishbone.get
tools.description: Return the Designer-style policy-flow fishbone JSON for one driver from an IDM-as-code tree (driverset.xml).

tree.description: Absolute path of the as-code tree root.

driver.description: Driver name; omitted = first driver in driverset.xml.

tools.run: bin/idm query <tree> fishbone <driver> --json   (or node extensions/dirxmldev-visual/out/cli.js dump <tree> [driver])

tools.name: fishbone.refresh
tools.description: Reload an open fishbone webview from disk after agent edits. Does not write policies.

tree.description: As-code tree root (sentinel is written here).

tools.run: touch <tree>/.dirxmldev/fishbone.refresh   # or VS Code command dirxmldev.fishbone.refresh

tools.name: fishbone.reveal
tools.description: Resolve a fishbone node (bone key, policy ref, or node id) to a content file path for the editor to open.

ref.description: Artifact path (drivers/D/subscriber/…), bone key (subscriber-event), or node id.
